feature: Shared cluster/EDS circuit request budgets and active-permit lifecycle

behavior.identity: process-owned registry key is exact cluster plus EDS service name; ordinary/shared channels reuse active count with independently configured per-picker limits
behavior.lifetime: reference-owned permits keep counters alive independently of policy/channel allocator/Io lifetime; last policy/permit release removes registry entry
behavior.reservation: pending readiness jobs hold no permit; atomic CAS reserves at transport admission and enforces maximum across racing owners; zero rejects new calls
behavior.rejection: EDS drops precede circuit check; saturated unary returns marked UNAVAILABLE with circuit breaker drop and no wire response, stream opening returns CallDropped; retries/hedging stop
behavior.completion: unary owner completion/failure releases job permit; active shared streams hold transferred permits until terminal/cancel/failure; ordinary duplex and client-streaming use one-shot observers and keep count after request FIN or intermediate messages
behavior.updates: SharedChannel policy replacement is transactional; lowering cap preserves active RPCs, raising allows new admission, replacing identity/disable leaves active old permits valid
behavior.eds: Snapshot TargetOptions support logical cluster identity and max_concurrent_requests default1024; publication installs circuit with target/drop/config state
behavior.telemetry: circuitStats exposes active/admitted/rejected values shared by identity; no policy returns empty local snapshot
behavior.validation: identity text bounds, cancellation and deadline precedence, candidate allocation rollback; internal protocol/health channels do not inherit application circuit
behavior.structure: cohesive circuit policy/registry and shared admission helper with adjacent unit, real-RPC and stream lifecycle tests

targeted_debug.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC circuit breaker' -Dtest-filter='gRPC EDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC drop policy' --summary all
